title: TNO
content:
TNO is the Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research, an independent innovation organization that connects industry, government and academia to translate research into practical products and applications.

Its built-environment and materials programs study aerogel-enhanced insulation systems for building energy retrofits, including cavity-wall applications and composite insulating materials based on silica aerogel, and take part in national consortium projects for housing renovation.

TNO offers testing, modelling and joint development services for porous insulation materials, covering hygrothermal performance, fire safety and life-cycle assessment.
excerpt: Dutch applied research organization studying aerogel-enhanced insulation for building energy retrofits and the performance of porous insulation materials.
